description: Read any document on the PC, also ones that are not in the company knowledge base.

tools.name: document.read
tools.description: Read the text of any file by absolute path: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, Markdown, CSV, JSON, text; images are described and audio/video transcribed by the local models (slow: up to minutes). Sections are labelled ([trang 3], [sheet 'A' · dòng 1–40], [slide 2]...).

tools.name: file.info
tools.description: Facts about ONE file or folder by absolute path: where it is (folder), its type and size, AUTHORS (the file's own Authors property as Explorer shows it), who saved it last, the day it FIRST APPEARED (first_seen: earliest of the file-system creation time and the first time the company catalog saw it: this is the file's 'ngày tạo'), the creation date written inside the document, last modified, pages, owner. Use it for 'file này ở đâu / ai tạo / tạo khi nào / do ai sửa'. To FIND files by name first use knowledge.query or filesystem.list.

tools.name: data.aggregate
tools.description: EXACT numbers from a table, computed by code: sum, mean, min, max, median, count, count_nonempty or distinct of one column of a .csv / .xlsx / .json file, or of every table file in a folder (rows are combined), optionally filtered (where) or grouped (group_by). Use it for any 'tổng / trung bình / lớn nhất / đếm / có bao nhiêu' over file data instead of adding numbers yourself: it reads the real files, understands 1.950.000 and 1,950,000.50, and tells you how many rows it used. Column names match without accents or case.

path.description: a table file or a folder of table files
